description: Five trained, near-perfect query-conditioned bilinear attention toys. Primitive and AND queries only enter weight/sequence cut fitting; XOR queries are held out from featurizer fitting and all selection. All tasks were in native model training. Exact per-key head table is used for evaluation; projector ranks 2/4/6/7/8. Uniform table rows versus empirical sequence head activations; all-query weight rows are an explicitly leaky oracle. Independent uniform and shifted-token tests.
